name: search
description: Search for files or text in the project. mode="content" (default): grep through file contents and rank definitions/source files first. mode="files": rank filename and path matches. Use isRegexp for regex patterns (e.g. 'word1|word2' for alternation).

pattern.description: Text or regex pattern to search for.

isRegexp.description: True if pattern is a regex.

path.description: Directory to search in (defaults to project root).
